segments.an6.14:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an6.14:1.3: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.an6.14:2.1: “Tathā tathā, āvuso, bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā [kālaṃkiriyā (ka.) a. ni.3.110].
segments.an6.14:2.2: Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā?
segments.an6.14:3.1: “Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kammārāmo hoti kammarato kammārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhassārāmo hoti bhassarato bhassārāmataṃ anuyutto, niddārāmo hoti niddārato niddārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṅgaṇikārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsaggārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsaggārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañcārāmo hoti papañcarato papañcārāmataṃ anuyutto.
segments.an6.14:3.2: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
segments.an6.14:3.4: ‘bhikkhu sakkāyābhirato nappajahāsi [na pahāsi (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] sakkāyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya’”.
segments.an6.14:4.1: “Tathā tathāvuso, bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
segments.an6.14:4.2: Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, bhaddikā kālakiriyā?
segments.an6.14:5.1: “Idhāvuso, bhikkhu na kammārāmo hoti na kammarato na kammārāmataṃ anuyutto, na bhassārāmo hoti na bhassarato na bhassārāmataṃ anuyutto, na niddārāmo hoti na niddārato niddārāmataṃ anuyutto, na saṅgaṇikārāmo hoti na saṅgaṇikarato na saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto, na saṃsaggārāmo hoti na saṃsaggarato na saṃsaggārāmataṃ anuyutto, na papañcārāmo hoti na papañcarato na papañcārāmataṃ anuyutto.
segments.an6.14:5.2: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
segments.an6.14:5.4: ‘bhikkhu nibbānābhirato pajahāsi sakkāyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā’”ti.

lines: Tattha yo hi bhītabhīto marati, tassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti.
Yo apāye paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhāti, tassa na bhaddikā kālakiriyā hoti.
Sā “ekassa dutiyo hoti, dvinnaṃ hoti tatiyako”tiādinā nayena veditabbā.
Sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyāti hetunā nayena sakalavaṭṭadukkhassa parivaṭumaparicchedakaraṇatthaṃ.
14-15. Catutthe āramitabbaṭṭhena vā kammaṃ ārāmo etassāti kammārāmo.
Kamme rato na ganthadhure vipassanādhure vāti kammarato.
Punappunaṃ yuttoti tapparabhāvena anu anu yutto pasuto.
